tool_notes.news_search: Give up to 3 English keywords at a time. per_keyword is the number of articles per keyword (default 3, at most 5). The same article does not come back again. Read the results before you upload.
tool_notes.article_upload: Upload only the articles you will use, one per case you write. file = the file news_search returned, title = article title, source = article URL. Write the fs://article/<number> you get back in the case's address. Only the articles whose address you write in a case go on to the story planner (all uploaded ones if you write none).
tool_notes.article_get: Use it to read a case article you uploaded again. Put the address fs://article/<number> in as is. Do not use it for source document addresses (fs://source/...).

part_id.description: the id of the producer's part this item covers, copied from the brief as is (p1, p2, ...)

date.description: a date you checked in the article; an empty string if unknown

why_fit.description: one short sentence; write only the conclusion, no frames or field names
